description: Wire the ff-dscatalog schema-v4 side (dataset-catalog Req 32, tasks 33-37) on top of FEAT-001's ff-volume crate: make ff-dscatalog depend on ff-volume (no redefining the Volume type), bump SCHEMA_VERSION 3->4 adding the `volumes` and `dataset_volumes` tables, add the FORWARD v3->v4 migration that seeds one Volume per existing Repository and a DatasetVolume row per existing dataset (locator derived from storage_path, dual-read, NO bytes moved, no DROP of storage_path), switch resolution to go Dataset -> DatasetVolume -> Volume -> locator with a Volume Online check and a storage_path fallback for unmigrated rows, and support multivolume / shared-volume / uncataloged (VOL=SER+UNIT) resolution at the catalog layer. Finishes with the task-37 integration tests and the end-of-run doc/TCR/master updates, then the owner hand-off. DEPENDS ON FEAT-001 (ff-volume must exist and compile first). Steps follow plan.md items 11-18.
steps: Read context.json + this FEAT file FIRST, then plan.md items 11-18 and FEAT-001's findings (for the exact ff-volume type/module names and the AccessMode naming note). Confirm FEAT-001 left ff-volume compiling.

plan.md item 11: add `ff-volume = { path = "../ff-volume" }` to crates/ff-dscatalog/Cargo.toml [dependencies]; import ff_volume types with QUALIFIED paths (ff_volume::AccessMode, not a glob, to avoid clashing with ff-dscatalog::vsam_service::AccessMode); fix the U+2014 em dash in the Cargo.toml description line (`emulation —` -> `emulation --`). Do NOT redefine the Volume type in the catalog. Verify cargo check -p ff-dscatalog compiles. Validates Req 32.8.

plan.md item 12 (TDD): in schema.rs bump SCHEMA_VERSION to "4", extend the version-history doc, add CREATE_VOLUMES_TABLE + CREATE_DATASET_VOLUMES_TABLE consts matching dataset-catalog design.md exactly, CREATE them in initialize_database, and append the v3->v4 entry to MIGRATIONS (index 2 -> ("4", ...)). UPDATE the existing schema tests that assert version '3' (migration_from_v1_to_v2_* / migration_from_v2_to_v3_* / metadata_contains_expected_keys) to expect '4', and add a chained-to-v4 assertion. Validates Req 32.1, 32.2.

plan.md item 13 (TDD): implement the v3->v4 SEED as a Rust step (migrate_v3_to_v4(conn, repo_root, catalog_name) in schema.rs or a new schema_v4.rs if schema.rs nears 400 lines) that CREATEs the tables, INSERTs one volumes row (volser from catalog_name uppercased, storage_uri=repo_root, status Online, access_mode ReadWrite, capacity via ff_volume::migration::volume_over_repository), and INSERTs a dataset_volumes row per datasets row (locator=storage_path, sequence 1, is_primary 1) via ff_volume::migration::seed_dataset_volumes. Wire it into the mount path (catalog.rs/repository.rs) where repo root + catalog name are known. apply_migrations(conn) still bumps the version + creates tables so a connection-only migration never corrupts the DB. Keep storage_path (NO DROP). Validates Req 32.5.

plan.md item 14 (TDD): add resolution via dataset_volumes (ordered by sequence_number) -> volumes -> locator with a status='Online' check (map Offline to a reported CatalogError identifying the first unavailable volume -- add a VolumeUnavailable variant to error.rs), and a storage_path dual-read FALLBACK when a dataset has no dataset_volumes row. Keep ResolveResult.physical_path populated. Validates Req 32.3, 32.4.

plan.md item 15 (TDD): ensure the schema permits many catalogs on one shared volume and one dataset across multiple volumes (multiple dataset_volumes rows, ascending sequence); add a catalog-layer resolve_uncataloged(volser, unit) delegating to ff_volume's resolver with no datasets row. Validates Req 32.6, 32.7.

plan.md item 16 (TDD): add crates/ff-dscatalog/tests/schema_v4.rs integration test covering task-37 scenarios end-to-end (dual-read migration, volume resolution, uncataloged resolve, shared-volume registration) with `// Validates: Requirement 32.x` comments.

plan.md item 17 (docs, AFTER code is green -- do NOT pre-mark): tick docs/specs/volume-model/tasks.md tasks 1-10 (NOT 11); tick docs/specs/dataset-catalog/tasks.md tasks 33-37; add ff-dscatalog Req 32.1-32.8 rows + a new ff-volume crate section (volume-model Req 1-11) to docs/quality/TCR.md with the test names, using the TCR emoji set; tick/add the RC.B.5 deliverable line(s) and update Summary counts in docs/project-management/project-master/tasks.md (main-workspace copy only). Keep docs ASCII (no em dash / curly quotes).

Run scoped checks via the pwsh7 wrapper after each item and at the end: cargo check -p ff-dscatalog; cargo test -p ff-dscatalog; cargo clippy -p ff-dscatalog -- -D warnings; cargo fmt. Also re-run the -p ff-volume checks to confirm FEAT-001 still builds. Fix failures attributable to this FEAT and rerun until clean.

plan.md item 18: STOP and hand off -- state exactly which scoped commands ran and prompt the owner to run the full `cargo gate --build` manually. Record in findings the out-of-scope downstream risks (storage_path readers in ff-dsalloc/ff-idcams/ff-files-panel/etc.; the ff-governance-tests dependency-direction allow-list likely needs an ff-volume rule; any lingering SCHEMA_VERSION=='3' assertions) that the owner's full gate may surface. Set this FEAT status to completed. Commit nothing (NO commit -- leave uncommitted).
acceptance_criteria: ff-dscatalog depends on ff-volume (Cargo.toml) and does NOT redefine the Volume type; the em dash in the description is fixed to '--'.
SCHEMA_VERSION is '4'; a fresh DB creates the `volumes` and `dataset_volumes` tables matching dataset-catalog design.md; existing schema tests updated from '3' to '4' and pass.
The v3->v4 migration seeds a Volume per Repository + a DatasetVolume per dataset (locator from storage_path), moves NO bytes, and retains the storage_path column (dual-read) -- proven by tests.
Resolution goes Dataset -> DatasetVolume -> Volume -> locator with an Online check (offline reports the first unavailable volume) and falls back to storage_path for unmigrated rows.
Shared-volume (two catalogs, one volume), multivolume (one dataset, two volumes), and uncataloged (VOL=SER+UNIT, no catalog row) resolution are covered by tests.
crates/ff-dscatalog/tests/schema_v4.rs passes and maps to Req 32.1-32.7.
`cargo check/test/clippy -p ff-dscatalog` are clean, `cargo fmt -- --check` passes, and the -p ff-volume checks still pass; new/changed .rs files are under 400 non-test lines.
volume-model tasks 1-10 and dataset-catalog tasks 33-37 are ticked; TCR gains ff-volume + Req 32 rows; project-master RC.B.5 line + Summary updated (main-workspace copies only).
Nothing is committed; the owner is prompted to run the full gate; downstream full-gate risks are recorded in findings.
findings:
FEAT-002 COMPLETE (plan.md items 11-18). ff-dscatalog now depends on ff-volume and wires the schema-v4 Volume split; nothing committed (uncommitted on branch main). All code is green on SCOPED checks (full cargo gate --build is the owner's manual step, NOT run here).

WHAT WAS DONE:
- item 11: added `ff-volume = { path = "../ff-volume" }` to crates/ff-dscatalog/Cargo.toml [dependencies]; fixed the U+2014 em dash in the Cargo.toml description ('emulation --'); also fixed stray em dashes in lib.rs doc comments. ff_volume types imported with qualified paths (ff_volume::VolumeId / DatasetId / Volser / Volume / VolumeRegistry; ff_volume::volume_over_repository / seed_dataset_volumes; ff_volume::dataset_volume::resolve_uncataloged) -- NO glob import, so the existing ff-dscatalog::vsam_service::AccessMode is not shadowed. The catalog does NOT redefine the Volume type (Req 32.8).
- item 12: schema.rs SCHEMA_VERSION bumped '3'->'4'; version-history doc extended; the v3->v4 table DDL (CREATE_V4_TABLES, plus CREATE_VOLUMES_TABLE / CREATE_DATASET_VOLUMES_TABLE consts) lives in a NEW module crates/ff-dscatalog/src/schema_v4.rs (schema.rs was already near the 400-line budget). initialize_database CREATEs the two v4 tables on fresh DBs; MIGRATIONS gained the index-2 ('4', CREATE_V4_TABLES) entry so apply_migrations(conn) bumps the version + creates tables (connection-only migration never corrupts). Tables match dataset-catalog design.md exactly (volumes: volume_id PK, volser UNIQUE NOT NULL, storage_uri NOT NULL, status/access_mode CHECKs, total_units/used_units; dataset_volumes: dataset_id REFERENCES datasets(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, volume_id REFERENCES volumes(volume_id), sequence_number, is_primary, locator, PRIMARY KEY(dataset_id, sequence_number)). Existing schema tests that asserted version '3' updated to '4' (migration_from_v1_to_v2_*, migration_from_v2_to_v3_*, migration_from_v1_to_v3_*, metadata_contains_expected_keys) plus a chained-to-v4 table-existence assertion; new tests schema_v4_creates_volumes_and_dataset_volumes + fresh_db_reports_version_4.
- item 13: schema_v4::migrate_v3_to_v4(conn, repo_root, catalog_name) seeds ONE volumes row (volser=catalog_name uppercased via ff_volume::volume_over_repository, storage_uri=repo_root, status Online, access_mode ReadWrite, total_units=MIGRATION_DEFAULT_CAPACITY_TRACKS=1_000_000) and a dataset_volumes row per existing datasets row (locator=storage_path, sequence 1, is_primary 1) via ff_volume::seed_dataset_volumes. It is IDEMPOTENT (skips when a volumes row already exists for repo_root), moves NO bytes, keeps storage_path (NO DROP). Wired into Catalog::mount (catalog.rs) AFTER the catalog name is read, where repo root + name are known.
- item 14: resolution now goes Dataset -> dataset_volumes (ORDER BY sequence_number) -> volumes -> locator with a status='Online' check; the FIRST non-Online required Volume is reported via a NEW CatalogError::VolumeUnavailable { volser, reason, operation } variant (error.rs). A dataset with NO dataset_volumes row FALLS BACK to repo_root.join(storage_path) (dual-read). CatalogRegistry::resolve and resolve_scoped now call catalog.resolve_locator(&entry) (ResolveResult.physical_path still populated). The resolution helpers live in a NEW module crates/ff-dscatalog/src/catalog_resolve.rs (free fns over &Connection + repo root) to keep catalog.rs from growing the 400-line concern further; Catalog has thin delegating methods resolve_locator / resolve_uncataloged.
- item 15: schema permits shared volume (many catalogs) + multivolume (ordered dataset_volumes) -- no constraint forbids it (asserted at the schema level). CatalogRegistry::resolve_uncataloged(volser, unit) -> (catalog_name, PathBuf) delegates per mounted catalog to catalog_resolve::resolve_uncataloged, which builds an ff_volume::VolumeRegistry from the volumes rows and calls ff_volume::dataset_volume::resolve_uncataloged. (Returns a path + catalog name rather than a ResolveResult because an uncataloged dataset has no DatasetRecord/DSN.)
- item 16: crates/ff-dscatalog/tests/schema_v4.rs integration test (6 tests) covers dual-read migration resolution, storage_path fallback, no-bytes-moved + storage_path retained, uncataloged VOL=SER+UNIT resolve (+ unknown-VOLSER reported), and shared-volume two-catalog registration, each with // Validates: Requirement 32.x.
- item 17 (docs, after code green): ticked volume-model tasks 1-10 (NOT 11) and dataset-catalog tasks 33-37; added an ff-volume crate section (volume-model Req 1-11) + ff-dscatalog Req 32.1-32.8 rows to docs/quality/TCR.md with test names (TCR emoji set); ticked project-master VM.2-VM.5 + RC.B.5 and added a code-complete status note to the RC phase summary (main-workspace copy only). New source files are ASCII-only; new TCR rows carry no em dash / curly quotes.
